files.README.md:
# ghost-todo-api

A tiny JSON todo API for the undead.

    npm install
    npm start

Built with Express 3 on Node 0.10. Last touched October 2014.

vitals.name: ghost-todo-api
vitals.description: A tiny JSON todo API for the undead. Express 3, circa 2014.
vitals.causeOfDeath: Bundled Connect middleware removed in Express 4 (app.js:11)

deps.name: node-uuid
deps.cause: Renamed to `uuid` in 2016; Node 14.17+ has crypto.randomUUID().

deps.name: express
deps.cause: Express 3 → 5: bundled Connect middleware removed, app.configure/app.router gone, res.send(status, body) and req.param() removed.

deps.name: moment
deps.cause: Moment is in maintenance mode and recommends lighter, immutable alternatives.

deps.name: request
deps.cause: Deprecated since Feb 2020. Node 18+ ships a native fetch().

deps.name: mocha
deps.cause: Legacy test runner; node:test is built into Node 20+.

action.reason: Replaced by the generated node:test suite.

deps.name: should
deps.cause: Prototype-extending assertion library; node:assert is built in.

action.reason: Replaced by the generated node:test suite.

configs.title: Travis CI config
configs.cause: travis-ci.org shut down in 2021; targets Node 0.10, 0.8. CI has been silently dead.
configs.remedy: Replace with a GitHub Actions workflow on Node 20/22.

configs.title: JSHint config
configs.cause: JSHint does not understand modern syntax and is superseded by ESLint.
configs.remedy: Translate options and globals into an ESLint 9 flat config.

configs.title: engines.node "0.10.x"
configs.cause: Pinned to a Node.js release that reached end-of-life years ago.

configs.title: No lockfile
configs.cause: Installs are not reproducible; the dependency tree drifts on every install.
configs.remedy: Commit the package-lock.json generated by the first `npm install`.

configs.title: No license
configs.cause: Nobody can legally reuse the resurrected code.

should@3.1.2 → removed — Replaced by the generated node:test suite.

name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm test
